observed_value: cost_currency flags include U_USD and U_EUR
anchor_value: source schedule reports amortized cost and fair value in dollars

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Albion Fortress Intermediate Holdings LLC | First Lien - Term Loan | EURIBOR + 575 | Par/Shares EUR 23,474,732 | Amortized Cost 26,175 | Fair Value 26,591

findings.detail: FX03 is treating XBRL/unit or instrument currency as a defect even though source valuation columns and totals are dollar-denominated.

rationale: Raw source shows foreign-currency denomination for at least one loan principal/reference-rate row, but the filing's investment schedule reports amortized cost and fair value in dollar-denominated schedule columns and dollar total rows. The flag therefore appears to be caused by rule scope/unit-code handling, not by non-USD BDC valuation amounts. Source was readable via the evidence CLI.
